      "target": "THE DEAN",

      "description": "Darbey returns for his violin and the Dean runs after him to offer an explanation.",

      "confidence": 0.8
    },

      "target": "Dandy",

      "target": "Dandy",

      "confidence": 0.8
    },

      "target": "Dandy",
      "relation": "INTERACTS_WITH",
      "description": "Hatcham reports that Dandy is feeding steadily and expresses concern about the horse's tail.",
      "evidence_quote": "Dandy is a feedin' as steady as a baby with a bottle.",
      "source_chunk_id": "dd_act02_c0007",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "source": "HATCHAM",
      "target": "Mr. Topping",
      "relation": "INTERACTS_WITH",
      "description": "Hatcham has got hold of the constable Mr. Topping, who is going to sit up with him.",
      "evidence_quote": "I've got hold of the constable 'ere, Mr. Topping--he's going to sit up with me",
      "source_chunk_id": "dd_act02_c0007",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "source": "HATCHAM",
      "target": "the \"Swan\"",
      "relation": "LOCATED_AT",
      "description": "Hatcham refers to a fire at the 'Swan' and suspects it might not have been an accident.",
      "evidence_quote": "supposin' the fire at the \"Swan\" warn't no accident!",
      "source_chunk_id": "dd_act02_c0007",
      "confidence": 0.7
    },
    {
      "source": "Dandy",
      "target": "the Deanery",
      "relation": "LOCATED_AT",
      "description": "Dandy is in the Deanery, as Georgiana says he knows he's in the Deanery.",
      "evidence_quote": "He knows he's in the Deanery too.",
      "source_chunk_id": "dd_act02_c0007",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },

      "source": "THE DEAN",

      "evidence_quote": "THE DEAN enters, followed by BLORE, who carries a lighted lantern.",
      "source_chunk_id": "dd_act02_c0007",
      "confidence": 0.8
    }
  ],
  "no_fact_reason": null
